# EasyModeKorea

> Free, independent guide for visitors to Korea: which Korean apps work with a foreign phone number and a foreign card, checked and dated. English, Japanese and Traditional Chinese. No ads, no affiliate links.

Answers depend on the visitor's setup: no Korean number, a Korean prepaid SIM (010), or residence (ARC). Each page states the setup and the date it was last checked.

- [Incheon Airport to Seoul](incheon-airport-to-seoul.html)
- [Does Google Maps work in Korea?](maps.html)

- [T-money top-up with a foreign card](tmoney-subway-bus.html)
- [Booking KTX trains as a foreigner](ktx-train-booking.html)
- [Restaurant bookings without a Korean number](restaurant-reservations.html)
- [Food delivery as a tourist](food-delivery.html)
- [Translation apps](translation.html)
- [What changed in 2026](changes.html)
